sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "calories" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("calories" >= 0.0), "protein" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein" >= 0.0), "carbs" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs" >= 0.0), "fat" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat" >= 0.0), "serving_weight_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("serving_weight_g" > 0.0), "display_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'g' CHECK("display_unit" IN ('g', 'oz')), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "fiber" REAL NULL CHECK("fiber" >= 0.0), "sugar" REAL NULL CHECK("sugar" >= 0.0), "sodium" REAL NULL CHECK("sodium" >= 0.0), "barcode" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_food_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "weight_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_g" > 0.0), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_log_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "log_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entry_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("entry_type" IN ('food', 'meal', 'adhoc')), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "calories" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("calories" >= 0.0), "protein" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein" >= 0.0), "carbs" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs" >= 0.0), "fat" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat" >= 0.0), "food_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "meal_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES meals (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "servings" REAL NULL CHECK("servings" > 0.0), "meal_slot" TEXT NULL CHECK("meal_slot" IN ('breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', 'snack')), "fiber" REAL NULL CHECK("fiber" >= 0.0), "sugar" REAL NULL CHECK("sugar" >= 0.0), "sodium" REAL NULL CHECK("sodium" >= 0.0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_log_entry_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES food_log_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_g" > 0.0), "calories" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("calories" >= 0.0), "protein" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein" >= 0.0), "carbs" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs" >= 0.0), "fat" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat" >= 0.0), "fiber" REAL NULL CHECK("fiber" >= 0.0), "sugar" REAL NULL CHECK("sugar" >= 0.0), "sodium" REAL NULL CHECK("sodium" >= 0.0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays" INTEGER NULL CHECK("weekdays" IS NULL OR "weekdays" BETWEEN 1 AND 127), "meal_slot" TEXT NULL CHECK("meal_slot" IN ('breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', 'snack')), "servings" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0 CHECK("servings" > 0.0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((meal_id IS NULL) <> (food_item_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_meal_outcomes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scheduled_meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('logged', 'dismissed')), "entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES food_log_entries (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("scheduled_meal_id", "date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_weights" ("log_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_kg" > 0.0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("log_date"));
